custom-pets.evidence: Actual stock pet loader uses Windows home with POSIX joins. Isolated patched loader discovers, selects and installs using the backend path format.

browser-wsl.evidence: Actual stock in-app eligibility function returns wsl-disabled. Exhaustive source-function cases retain every other prerequisite.

browser-service-path.evidence: Actual stock cc generator registers a POSIX browser path for a Windows worker. Corrected generator uses its existing native converter only with WSL paths on win32.

project-memberships.evidence: Actual native project membership synchronizer is separately gated by localProjectTaskMembership. Gate-off leaves desktop assignments unpersisted. Isolated actual-source tests cover initial migration, named projects sharing cwd, new assignments, moves, clearing and backend/host guards; full phone UI acceptance remains separate.

wsl-project-paths.evidence: Stock CLI 0.159.0 rejects matching WSL UNC project/create roots. The portable proxy + relay + stock CLI returns the canonical POSIX root in an isolated home/database; EOF and SIGTERM cleanup release the relay port.

remote-fast-list.evidence: Direct unmodified CLI 0.159.0 native mock Remote Control returns project-filtered SQLite witnesses, but unfiltered incoming thread/list with useStateDbOnly:false and omitted useStateDbOnly both omit all 2 witnesses. Relay returns them, preserving project filters, pagination, native pairing reuse and cursor reconnect. Full phone UI acceptance remains pending.
